mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals sustained monetary accommodation, lowering discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% across any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% in a 3-month window signals economic weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment that depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (p>0.05) over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO growth < 0.5% for two consecutive months) reduces corporate output capacity, lowering earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth remains below 0.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth above 2.0% signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days without conditional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% across any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals synchronized economic recovery and policy support, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and FEDFUNDS decline fails to produce positive SPX 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (p>0.05) over 5-year periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 500.0 thousand units signal housing market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is below 500.0 over any 2-year period.
